standard_prerequisites.name: For K-flat K and complexes M, I there is a canonical map Tot(K tensor Hom(M, I)) -> Hom(M, Tot(K tensor I))
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the first map of the composite defining the morphism.

core_obligations: Represent K by a K-flat complex K, L by a K-injective complex I and M by any complex M; choose a quasi-isomorphism Tot(K tensor I) -> J with J K-injective (proof lines 18811-18816). The composite Tot(K tensor Hom(M, I)) -> Hom(M, Tot(K tensor I)) -> Hom(M, J), whose first arrow is the diagonal-better map, defines in D(R) a morphism K tensor RHom(M, L) -> RHom(M, K tensor L); K-flatness of K and K-injectivity of J make the outer terms compute the derived functors, and functoriality in K, L, M follows from the functoriality of the diagonal-better map and of the K-injective resolution (proof lines 18817-18826).
proof_roadmap: Choose representatives and a K-injective resolution of the tensor product (proof lines 18811-18816).
Define the morphism via the diagonal-better map into the Hom into the resolution (proof lines 18817-18826).
difficulty_reason: 18 行、张量-内积对角态射（加强版）：选 K 的 K-平坦代表、L 的 K-内射代表、M 任意代表，取 Tot(K⊗I) 的 K-内射消解 J；复合对角引理的映射 Tot(K⊗Hom(M,I)) -> Hom(M,Tot(K⊗I)) 与 Hom(M,-) 到 J 的诱导映射，得 K ⊗ RHom(M,L) -> RHom(M,K⊗L)；K-平坦性与 K-内射性保证各外项算出导出函子。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。
